operating-systems/final.answer:
A logical (virtual) address is generated by the CPU; a physical address is the address seen by the memory unit. They are the same with compile-time and load-time binding and differ with execution-time binding.
邏輯（虛擬）位址由 CPU 產生；實體位址是記憶體單元看到的位址。compile time、load time 綁定時兩者相同，execution time 綁定時不同。

The MMU is the hardware device that at run time maps virtual (logical) addresses to physical addresses. In the simplest scheme the base register becomes the relocation register, whose value is added to every address generated by a user process when it is sent to memory.
MMU 是在執行時把虛擬位址轉成實體位址的硬體。最簡單的做法是把 base register 當 relocation register，user process 送到記憶體的每個位址都加上它的值。

External fragmentation: total memory space exists to satisfy a request, but it is not contiguous. Internal fragmentation: allocated memory may be slightly larger than requested memory; the difference is memory internal to a partition that is not being used.
外部碎片：總空間夠，但不連續。內部碎片：配給的記憶體比要求的稍大，多出來的在分割區內卻沒被使用。

A translation look-aside buffer is a small, fast associative memory (hardware cache) that holds recent page-number-to-frame-number translations and is searched in parallel. Without it every data or instruction access needs two memory accesses (page table + data).
TLB 是小而快的關聯式記憶體（硬體快取），存最近用過的頁號對 frame 號，可平行搜尋。沒有它的話每次存取都要兩次記憶體存取（page table＋資料）。

Given N allocated blocks, another 0.5N blocks are lost to fragmentation, so about one third of memory may be unusable: 0.5N / (N + 0.5N) = 1/3.
配置 N 塊時，另外約 0.5N 塊因碎片浪費，所以大約三分之一記憶體可能不能用：0.5N / (N + 0.5N) = 1/3。

Compile time: if the memory location is known a priori, absolute code can be generated; the code must be recompiled if the starting location changes. Load time: the compiler must generate relocatable code if the location is not known at compile time; binding happens when loading. Execution time: binding is delayed until run time if the process can be moved during execution from one memory segment to another; this needs hardware support for address maps (e.g. base and limit registers, MMU).
Compile time：事先知道位置就產生絕對碼，起點一改就要重編。Load time：編譯時不知道位置就產生可重定位碼，載入時綁定。Execution time：process 執行中可能被搬動就延到執行時綁定，需要硬體支援位址對應（base／limit、MMU）。

First-fit: 212K → 500K (288K left); 417K → 600K (183K left); 112K → 288K (176K left); 426K must wait. Best-fit: 212K → 300K; 417K → 500K; 112K → 200K; 426K → 600K. Worst-fit: 212K → 600K (388K left); 417K → 500K; 112K → 388K; 426K must wait. Best-fit is the most efficient here: it is the only one that places all four.
First-fit：212K→500K（剩 288K）、417K→600K（剩 183K）、112K→288K（剩 176K）、426K 要等。Best-fit：212K→300K、417K→500K、112K→200K、426K→600K。Worst-fit：212K→600K（剩 388K）、417K→500K、112K→388K、426K 要等。這題 best-fit 最好，只有它四個都放得下。

Page size 4, so page = address div 4, offset = address mod 4, physical = frame × 4 + offset. 5 → page 1, offset 1 → 6 × 4 + 1 = 25. 10 → page 2, offset 2 → 1 × 4 + 2 = 6. 15 → page 3, offset 3 → 2 × 4 + 3 = 11.
頁大小 4：頁號 = 位址 ÷ 4 的商、offset = 餘數，實體 = frame × 4 + offset。5 → 第 1 頁 offset 1 → 25；10 → 第 2 頁 offset 2 → 6；15 → 第 3 頁 offset 3 → 11。

EAT = α(m + ε) + (1 − α)(2m + ε). α = 0.90: 0.90 × 120 + 0.10 × 220 = 108 + 22 = 130 ns. α = 0.98: 0.98 × 120 + 0.02 × 220 = 117.6 + 4.4 = 122 ns. On a miss the frame number must be read from the page table in memory first, then the data itself is read.
EAT = α(m + ε) + (1 − α)(2m + ε)。α = 0.90：0.90 × 120 + 0.10 × 220 = 130 ns。α = 0.98：0.98 × 120 + 0.02 × 220 = 122 ns。miss 時要先到記憶體讀 page table 拿 frame 號，再讀資料，所以要兩次。

The offset must be less than the segment's limit, otherwise the hardware traps (addressing error); if it is legal the physical address is base + offset. <1, 10>: 10 < 400 → 6300 + 10 = 6310. <4, 112>: 112 < 1000 → 4700 + 112 = 4812. <1, 500>: 500 ≥ 400 → trap.
offset 必須小於該段 limit，否則硬體 trap（位址錯誤）；合法時實體位址 = base + offset。<1, 10> → 6310；<4, 112> → 4812；<1, 500>：500 ≥ 400 → trap。

2^32 / 2^12 = 2^20 (about 1 million) entries × 4 bytes = 4 MB per process, which we do not want to allocate contiguously. Hierarchical paging pages the page table itself: e.g. a two-level table where p1 indexes the outer table and p2 the inner table. Hashed page tables hash the virtual page number into a table whose entries are chains of (virtual page number, frame, next pointer); common for address spaces larger than 32 bits. An inverted page table has one entry per physical frame for the whole system, holding the virtual page and the owning process; it saves memory but takes longer to search (a hash table limits the search).
2^32 / 2^12 = 2^20 筆 × 4 bytes = 每個 process 4 MB，而且不想連續配置。階層式：把 page table 再分頁，例如兩層，p1 查外層、p2 查內層。雜湊：把虛擬頁號雜湊到表中，每格是（虛擬頁號、frame、下一個指標）的串列，適合 > 32 位元。反轉：整個系統一張，每個實體 frame 一筆，記虛擬頁與所屬 process；省記憶體但搜尋較久（用雜湊表限制搜尋）。

Demand paging brings a page into memory only when it is needed (referenced). A lazy swapper never swaps a page into memory unless that page will be needed; a swapper that deals with pages is a pager.
需求分頁：頁被參考（需要）時才載入記憶體。lazy swapper：不需要的頁絕不換入；以頁為單位的 swapper 叫 pager。

Belady's anomaly: for some page-replacement algorithms the page-fault rate may increase as the number of allocated frames increases. FIFO shows it (e.g. 1,2,3,4,1,2,5,1,2,3,4,5: 9 faults with 3 frames, 10 with 4).
Belady 異常：某些替換演算法 frame 變多，page fault 反而變多。FIFO 會（例如 1,2,3,4,1,2,5,1,2,3,4,5：3 個 frame 9 次、4 個 frame 10 次）。

Copy-on-write lets the parent and child initially share the same pages; a shared page is copied only when either process modifies it. Only modified pages are copied, so fork() is faster.
寫入時複製：父子一開始共用相同的頁，任一方修改某頁時才複製那頁。只複製被改的頁，所以 fork() 比較快。

Thrashing: a process does not have enough frames, so its page-fault rate is very high and it is busy swapping pages in and out, spending more time paging than executing; CPU utilization drops.
Thrashing：process 的 frame 不夠，page fault 率很高，一直在換頁，換頁時間比執行還多；CPU 使用率下降。

It records whether a page has been modified since it was loaded. Only modified (dirty) pages must be written back to disk when replaced, which reduces the overhead of page transfers.
記錄頁載入後有沒有被改過。只有被改過（dirty）的頁換出時才要寫回磁碟，減少傳輸負擔。

(1) The reference to a page marked invalid traps to the OS (page fault). (2) The OS checks another table: an invalid reference → abort; just not in memory → continue. (3) Get an empty (free) frame, using page replacement if none is free. (4) Swap the page into the frame via a scheduled disk operation. (5) Reset the tables to show the page is in memory; set the valid bit = v. (6) Restart the instruction that caused the page fault.
(1) 參考到標成 invalid 的頁 → trap 給 OS。(2) 查另一張表：非法參考就終止，只是不在記憶體就繼續。(3) 找空 frame（沒有就做替換）。(4) 排磁碟操作把頁讀進 frame。(5) 更新表格，valid bit 設成 v。(6) 重新執行造成 fault 的指令。

FIFO: 16 page faults. LRU: 15 page faults. Optimal: 11 page faults.
FIFO：16 次。LRU：15 次。Optimal：11 次。

The working-set window Δ is a fixed number of recent page references. WSS_i is the number of distinct pages process Pi referenced in the most recent Δ; it approximates its locality. D = Σ WSS_i is the total demand for frames. If D > m (total frames), thrashing will occur, so the OS suspends or swaps out one of the processes. Δ too small misses the locality; too large covers several localities.
Δ 是固定數量的最近頁參考。WSS_i 是 Pi 最近 Δ 次參考中用到的不同頁數，近似它的 locality。D = Σ WSS_i 是總 frame 需求。D > m（總 frame 數）就會 thrashing，所以暫停或換出某個 process。Δ 太小蓋不住 locality、太大會蓋到好幾個。

Buddy system: requests are rounded up to a power of 2 (21 KB → 32 KB). The 256 KB chunk is split into two 128 KB buddies (AL, AR), one 128 KB into two 64 KB (BL, BR), one 64 KB into two 32 KB (CL, CR), and one 32 KB buddy satisfies the request. Advantage: unused buddies coalesce quickly into larger chunks; disadvantage: fragmentation (11 KB wasted here). Slab allocator: a slab is one or more physically contiguous pages; a cache has one or more slabs and exists for each kernel data structure, filled with objects marked free or used. Advantages: no fragmentation and fast allocation.
Buddy：要求往上取 2 的次方（21 KB → 32 KB）。256 KB 切成兩個 128 KB，再把一個切成兩個 64 KB，再切成兩個 32 KB，用一個 32 KB。優點：很快合併成大塊；缺點：碎片（這裡浪費 11 KB）。Slab：slab 是一或多個實體連續頁；每種核心資料結構一個 cache，cache 由 slab 組成，裝滿標成 free／used 的 object。優點：沒有碎片、配置快。

Positioning time = seek time (time to move the disk arm to the desired cylinder) + rotational latency (time for the desired sector to rotate under the disk head).
定位時間 = seek time（手臂移到目標 cylinder 的時間）＋旋轉延遲（目標 sector 轉到讀寫頭下的時間）。

Disk bandwidth is the total number of bytes transferred divided by the total time between the first request for service and the completion of the last transfer.
磁碟頻寬 = 傳輸的總 bytes ÷ 從第一個要求到最後一次傳輸完成的總時間。

NAS (network-attached storage) makes storage available over an ordinary network, remotely attaching file systems with protocols such as NFS and CIFS via RPCs over TCP/UDP on IP. A SAN (storage-area network) is a separate network of storage arrays and hosts connected through Fibre Channel switches, giving block access.
NAS 透過一般網路提供儲存，用 NFS、CIFS（RPC over TCP/UDP）遠端掛載檔案系統。SAN 是獨立的儲存網路，儲存陣列和 host 接在 Fibre Channel 交換器上，提供區塊存取。

An SSD is nonvolatile memory with no moving parts: there is no arm to move and no platter to rotate.
SSD 是非揮發性記憶體，沒有機械零件：沒有要移動的手臂，也沒有要旋轉的盤片。

An unused disk that the RAID system automatically uses to replace a failed disk and rebuild the RAID set, which decreases the mean time to repair.
閒置的磁碟，RAID 有磁碟故障時自動頂替並重建，縮短平均修復時間。

One rotation = 60 / 10,000 s = 6 ms, so the average latency = 3 ms. Transfer = 4 MB ÷ 100 MB/s = 40 ms. Average I/O time = 4 + 3 + 40 + 0.2 = 47.2 ms.
轉一圈 = 60 / 10,000 秒 = 6 ms，平均旋轉延遲 = 3 ms。傳輸 = 4 MB ÷ 100 MB/s = 40 ms。平均 I/O 時間 = 4 + 3 + 40 + 0.2 = 47.2 ms。

RAID 0: block striping with no redundancy; survives 0 failures. RAID 1: mirroring, every disk has a duplicate; survives the failure of one disk of a pair. RAID 5: block-interleaved distributed parity, data and parity spread over all disks; survives 1 failure. RAID 6: P + Q redundancy (extra error-correcting information); survives 2 failures.
RAID 0：只 striping 不冗餘，壞 0 顆。RAID 1：鏡像，每顆有複本，一組裡壞一顆還行。RAID 5：區塊交錯、分散同位，可壞 1 顆。RAID 6：P + Q 冗餘，可壞 2 顆。

Replicate the information on more than one nonvolatile medium with independent failure modes, and update in a controlled way: keep two physical blocks per logical block, write the first, when that succeeds write the second, and declare the write complete only after the second succeeds; recovery restores a consistent state after a failure. Outcomes: successful completion, partial failure (only some sectors written, the one being written may be corrupted), total failure (the write never started, the old data are intact).
把資料複製在多個故障模式獨立的非揮發性媒介上並受控更新：每個邏輯區塊兩個實體區塊，先寫第一個，成功再寫第二個，第二個成功才算完成；故障後由恢復程序還原成一致狀態。三種結果：成功完成、部分失敗（只寫了部分 sector，正在寫的可能壞掉）、完全失敗（還沒開始寫，舊資料完好）。

SCAN (elevator) moves the arm from one end of the disk to the other, servicing requests, then reverses at the end. C-SCAN services requests in one direction only and returns to the beginning without servicing on the return trip, giving a more uniform wait time. LOOK is SCAN that reverses at the last request instead of going to the end of the disk. SSTF can starve requests far from the head. SSTF or LOOK is a reasonable default; SCAN and C-SCAN suit systems with a heavy disk load.
SCAN（電梯）手臂從一端走到另一端沿路服務，到底才回頭。C-SCAN 只單向服務，到底後直接回到開頭、回程不服務，等待時間較平均。LOOK 是走到最後一個要求就回頭的 SCAN。SSTF 會讓遠的要求飢餓。預設可選 SSTF 或 LOOK；磁碟負載重時 SCAN、C-SCAN 較好。

Mutual exclusion, hold and wait, no preemption, circular wait.
互斥、持有並等待、不可搶奪、循環等待。

Internal fragmentation and external fragmentation.
內部碎片、外部碎片。

(a) A cycle in the resource-allocation graph: with one instance per resource type, a cycle means deadlock. (b) No. Each resource type has several instances, so a cycle does not necessarily mean deadlock. P2 holds an instance of R1 and P4 an instance of R2, and neither waits for anything; when P2 releases R1 (or P4 releases R2), P1 or P3 can get it, so the cycle is broken and all processes can finish.
(a) 資源配置圖有環（cycle）；每種資源只有一個 instance 時，有環就是死結。(b) 不會。這是多 instance 的系統，有環不一定死結。P2 拿著 R1 的一個 instance、P4 拿著 R2 的一個 instance，它們不等任何資源；P2 釋放 R1（或 P4 釋放 R2）後，P1 或 P3 就能拿到，環被打破，大家都能完成。

Many-to-one, one-to-one, many-to-many, and two-level (a many-to-many model that also allows one-to-one binding).
多對一、一對一、多對多、雙層（多對多加上可綁定一對一的混合）。

For some page-replacement algorithms (e.g. FIFO), the page-fault rate may increase as the number of allocated frames increases. Example: the string 1,2,3,4,1,2,5,1,2,3,4,5 gives 9 faults with 3 frames but 10 with 4 frames under FIFO. Stack algorithms such as LRU and OPT do not have it.
某些替換演算法（例如 FIFO），frame 變多時 page fault 反而變多。例：1,2,3,4,1,2,5,1,2,3,4,5 用 FIFO，3 個 frame 9 次、4 個 frame 10 次。LRU、OPT 這類 stack algorithm 不會。（參考答案把原因寫成「降低 CPU 使用率」並不正確，重點只在 frame 多、fault 反而多。）

Thrashing: a process does not have enough frames, so it page-faults constantly and spends more time paging than executing; CPU utilization drops, the OS adds more processes to raise utilization, and it gets worse. Prevention: the working-set model (give each process enough frames for its working set; if the total demand D > m, suspend a process), page-fault frequency (add frames when the fault rate is too high, take them away when it is too low), and limiting the degree of multiprogramming / using local replacement.
Thrashing：process 的 frame 不夠，一直 page fault，換頁時間比執行還多；CPU 使用率下降，OS 又加 process 進來，越來越糟。預防：working-set model（給足工作集的 frame，總需求 D > m 就暫停一個 process）、page-fault frequency（fault 率高就加 frame、低就減）、限制多元程式程度或用區域替換。

TLB reach is the amount of memory accessible from the TLB: TLB reach = (TLB size) × (page size). Increase it by increasing the page size or by providing multiple page sizes.
TLB reach：靠 TLB 就能存取到的記憶體量 = TLB 筆數 × 頁大小。增加方法：加大頁大小，或提供多種頁大小。

(1) FIFO: 15. (2) Optimal: 9. (3) LRU: 12. (4) LFU: 13 (ties between pages with the same count broken by FIFO order, i.e. the page loaded earliest is replaced).
(1) FIFO：15 次。(2) Optimal：9 次。(3) LRU：12 次。(4) LFU：13 次（次數相同時，換掉最早載入的那頁）。原卷沒有附答案，這裡是算出來的。

(1) Total = Available + Σ Allocation: A = 3+2+3+2+1+1 = 12, B = 3+0+1+1+3+4 = 12, C = 2+0+2+0+1+3 = 8, D = 1+1+1+3+2+2 = 10 → (12, 12, 8, 10). (2) Need = Max − Allocation: P0 (2,2,1,1), P1 (2,1,3,1), P2 (0,2,1,3), P3 (0,1,1,2), P4 (2,2,3,3). (3) Yes. (1,1,0,0) ≤ Need P1 (2,1,3,1) and ≤ Available (3,3,2,1). Pretend to grant: Available = (2,2,2,1), Allocation P1 = (4,2,2,1), Need P1 = (1,0,3,1). Safety: P0 (2,2,1,1) ≤ (2,2,2,1) → Work (4,2,2,2); P3 (0,1,1,2) → (5,5,3,4); P4 (2,2,3,3) → (6,9,6,6); P1 (1,0,3,1) → (10,11,8,7); P2 (0,2,1,3) → (12,12,8,10). Safe sequence , so it can be granted. (4) No. (0,0,2,0) ≤ Need P4 (2,2,3,3) and ≤ Available (3,3,2,1), but after pretending to grant, Available = (3,3,0,1) and Need P4 = (2,2,1,3). Every process needs at least one C or more D than available (P0 needs C=1, P1 C=3, P2 C=1 and D=3, P3 C=1, P4 C=1), so no process can finish: the state is unsafe and P4 must wait.
(1) 總數 = Available + Allocation 加總 = (12, 12, 8, 10)。(2) Need = Max − Allocation：P0 (2,2,1,1)、P1 (2,1,3,1)、P2 (0,2,1,3)、P3 (0,1,1,2)、P4 (2,2,3,3)。(3) 可以。(1,1,0,0) ≤ Need 且 ≤ Available；假裝給了之後 Available = (2,2,2,1)，可找到安全序列 ，所以立刻給。(4) 不行。雖然 (0,0,2,0) ≤ Need 且 ≤ Available，但給了之後 Available = (3,3,0,1)，每個 process 都還要至少一個 C，沒人能完成 → unsafe，P4 要等。（原卷答案只寫到假裝分配，沒有做安全檢查；第 (4) 小題也誤寫成 P1。）

(a) EAT = α(m + ε) + (1 − α)(2m + ε) = 0.8 × (200 + 10) + 0.2 × (400 + 10) = 168 + 82 = 250 ns. (b) 210α + 410(1 − α) ≤ 230 → 410 − 200α ≤ 230 → α ≥ 0.9, so the hit ratio must be at least 90%: every miss costs an extra 200 ns memory access for the page table, so more hits are needed to bring the average down.
(a) EAT = 0.8 × 210 + 0.2 × 410 = 250 ns。(b) 210α + 410(1 − α) ≤ 230 → α ≥ 0.9，命中率至少 90%：每次 miss 要多一次 200 ns 去讀 page table，所以要更多命中才能把平均拉低。（原卷 (b) 把命中率寫成 ε，其實是 α。）

(a) 0.9 × (10 + 100) + 0.1 × (10 + 100 + 100) = 99 + 21 = 120 ns. (b) A miss now needs two page-table accesses plus the data access: 0.9 × 110 + 0.1 × (10 + 300) = 99 + 31 = 130 ns.
(a) 0.9 × 110 + 0.1 × 210 = 120 ns。(b) 兩層 page table，miss 時要讀兩次 page table 再讀資料：0.9 × 110 + 0.1 × 310 = 130 ns。（原卷題目漏了「10 ns」。）

(a) 8 = 2³ pages → 3 bits of page number; 1,024 = 2¹⁰ bytes → 10 bits of offset; logical address = 3 + 10 = 13 bits. (b) 32 = 2⁵ frames → 5 bits of frame number + 10 bits of offset = 15 bits.
(a) 8 = 2³ 頁 → 頁號 3 位；1,024 = 2¹⁰ → offset 10 位；邏輯位址 = 13 位。(b) 32 = 2⁵ 個 frame → 5 位 + offset 10 位 = 15 位。
